content: Nɑmɑni u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Sirin sinɑ bokon tɑbu sunɔ, mɑ u sɑ̃ɑ tɔn boko bɛɛrɛɡii win yinnin nɔni sɔɔ. Domi win min diyɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ Siriɡibu bɑ nɑsɑrɑ wɑ. Adɑmɑ tɑbu durɔ wi, u bɑrɑ disiɡiru mɔ win wɑsi sɔɔ.
N deemɑ Siriɡibu bɑ Isirelibɑn bii wɔndiɑ ɡoo mwɑɑmɑ sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ kɑ Isirelibɑ tɑbu kuɑ. Bii wiyɑ, u rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ Nɑmɑnin kurɔn mi.
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru bii wi, u kurɔ wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn yinni ù n dɑɑ dɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ wi u wɑ̃ɑ Sɑmɑriɔn mi u koo nùn bɛkiɑ.
Ye Nɑmɑni u ɡɑri yi nuɑ, yerɑ u seewɑ u dɑ u win yinni sinɑ boko sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, mɛni kɑ mɛniwɑ bii wɔndiɑ wi sɑ mwɑɑmɑ Isirelibɑn tem di u ɡeruɑ.

Mɑ sinɑ boko wi, u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑ de ɑ dɑ Sɑmɑri mi, kpɑ n Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko tireru yoruɑ n nun wɛ̃. Mɑ Nɑmɑni u seewɑ u sii ɡeesu suɑ kilo ɡoobɑ wunɔbu (300), kɑ wurɑ kilo wɑtɑ kɑ yɑbe kumboorosu wɔkuru.

Ye u turɑ mi, yerɑ u tire te Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko wɛ̃. Ye tɑ ɡeruɑ wee. Sinɑ boko, tire teni tɑ̀ n wunɛn nɔmu duɑ, ɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ nɛn tɑbu sunɔ Nɑmɑni suremɑ wunɛn mi, ɑ kɑ nùn win bɑrɑ disiɡiru bɛkiɑ.

Sɑɑ ye Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko u tire te ɡɑrɑ u kpɑ, yerɑ u win tiin yɑberu nɛnuɑ u kɑrɑnɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnun sɔ̃. U nɛɛ, nɑ rɑ ko Gusunɔ, wi u rɑ ɡo kpɑ u wure u wɑ̃ɑru wɛ̃? Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ u mɑn durɔ wi suremɑ n nùn bɛkiɑ. Bɛɛn tii i mɛɛrio i ǹ wɑ mɑ u mɑn nɔɔ kɑsuwɑ?
Sɑɑ ye Elisee Gusunɔn sɔmɔ u nuɑ sinɑ boko u win tiin yɑberu kɑrɑnɑ yerɑ u nùn ɡɔriɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ kuɑ mɛ. A de Nɑmɑni u nɑ nɛn mi, kpɑ u ɡiɑ mɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ u wɑ̃ɑ Isireliɔ.
Mɑ Nɑmɑni u seewɑ u dɑ mi kɑ dumi kɑ win tɑbu kɛkɛ yi dumi ɡɑwe. Mɑ u dɑ u yɔ̃rɑ Eliseen yɛnun kɔnnɔwɔ.
Yerɑ Elisee u sɔmɔ ɡɔrɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo ɑ Nɑmɑni sɔ̃ u doo u num nɔn nɔɔbɑ yiru Yuudɛnin dɑɑrun nim sɔɔ. Win wɑsi koo wurɑmɑ nɡe mɛ yi rɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ, kpɑ u dɛɛrɑ.
Ye Nɑmɑni u yeni nuɑ, yerɑ u mɔru bɑrɑ mɑ u ɡɔsirɑ u doonɔ u mɔ̀, nɑ rɑɑ tɑmɑɑ u koo yɑrimɑwɑ u yɔ̃rɑ nɛn wuswɑɑɔ u Gusunɔ win Yinni kɑnɑ, kpɑ u win nɔmɑ sɑɑsi mi nɛn bɑrɑ te, tɑ wɑ̃ɑ u mɑn bɛkiɑ.
Dɑmɑsin dɑɑ ni bɑ mɔ̀ Abɑnɑ kɑ Pɑripɑri, nin nim kun Isirelibɑn dɑɑrun nim burɑm kere? Nɑ ǹ kon dɑ n wobure mi kpɑ n dɛɛrɑ? Mɑ u sĩirɑ u doonɔ kɑ mɔru.
Adɑmɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ nùn susi, mɑ bɑ nùn dɑm kɑ̃ bɑ nɛɛ, bɑɑbɑ, Gusunɔn sɔmɔ wi, ù n dɑɑ nun ɡɑ̃ɑnu bikiɑ ni nu sɛ̃, ɑ ǹ kɑɑ ko? Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, yerɑ kɑɑ kpɑnɑ ɑ dɑ ɑ wobure ɑ kɑ dɛɛrɑ?
Yerɑ u sɑrɑ u duɑ nim mɛ sɔɔ u numɑ nɔn nɔɔbɑ yiru nɡe mɛ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ wi, u rɑɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Mɑ win wɑsin ɡɔnɑ yɑ wɛ̃rɑ nɡe bii piibuɡiɑ mɑ u dɛɛrɑ.

Yen biru u ɡɔsirɑmɑ Eliseen mi, kɑ win tɔn be bɑ nùn swĩi kpuro. Ye bɑ turɑ mi, yerɑ u yɔ̃rɑ Eliseen wuswɑɑɔ u nɛɛ, nɑ ɡiɑ tɛ̃, mɑ Yinni ɡoo sɑri tem kpuro sɔɔ mɑ n kun mɔ Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni. Yen sɔ̃, ɑ suuru koowo ɑ nɛn kɛ̃ru mɔɔ.
Mɑ Elisee u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, sere kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ wi nɑ sɑ̃ɑmɔn wɑ̃ɑru nɑ ǹ wunɛn kɛ̃ɛ te mwɑɑmɔ. Nɑmɑni u nùn kɔkurɑ. Kɑ mɛ, u yinɑ.

Yerɑ Nɑmɑni u nɛɛ, yinni, wee ɑ nɛn kɛ̃nu yinɑ. A de n tem sɔkɑ kɛtɛkunu yirun sɔmunun sɑkɑ n kɑ dɑ nɛn yɛnuɔ. Domi nɑ ǹ mɑɑ kĩ n yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinu ǹ kun mɛ siɑrɑbuɡinu ko ɡɑ̃ɑnu ɡɑnun nuurɔ, mɑ n kun mɔ Yinni Gusunɔn mi.
Adɑmɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑn suuru kuɑ, nɑ̀ n nɛn yinni Sirin sunɔn nɔmɑ nɛnuɑ su kɑ dɑ bũu wi bɑ rɑ soku Rimɔɔn dirɔ, mɑ nɑ yiirɑ kɑ wi sɑnnu mi.
Elisee u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo kɑ bɔri yɛndu. Mɑ u doonɑ. Gehɑsin torɑru Ye Nɑmɑni u doonɑ Eliseen min di u tondɑ fiiko,
yerɑ Gehɑsi Eliseen ɑluwɑɑsi wi, u bwisikɑ u nɛɛ, wee, nɛn yinni kun Nɑmɑni Siriɡii wi ɡɑ̃ɑnu mwɑɑri ni u kɑ nɑ sɔɔ. Yen sɔ̃, sere kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn wɑ̃ɑru kon nùn nɑɑ ɡirɑwɑ kpɑ n nùn ɡɑ̃ɑnu mwɑɑri.
Yerɑ Gehɑsi u Nɑmɑni nɑɑ ɡirɑ. Ye Nɑmɑni u nùn wɑ u bu nɑɑ ɡire biruɔ, yerɑ u yɔ̃ɔwɑ sɑɑ win tɑbu kɛkɛn di u surɑ, u nɑ u kɑ Gehɑsi yinnɑ. Mɑ u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, n kɑ do mɛ?

Gehɑsi u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, n do ɡbɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑ̃ɑ. Nɛn yinniwɑ u mɑn ɡɔrimɑ. U nɛɛ, wee ye yɑ nùn deemɑ. Gusunɔn sɔmɔn bwɑ̃ɑbu yiru ɡɑbɑ nɑ sɑɑ Efɑrɑimun ɡuurun berɑn di. A be nùn sii ɡeesun kilo tɛnɑ kɑ yɑbe ɡeenu yiru wɛ̃ɛmɑ ben sɔ̃.
Nɑmɑni u nùn kɔkurɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ yɑnde kilo wɑtɑ suo. Mɑ u sii ɡee si doke sɑɑki yiru sɔɔ, mɑ u nùn yɑbenu yiru ye wɛ̃. Yerɑ u win ɑluwɑɑsibɑ sɔɔ, tɔnu yiru wunɑ bu kɑ nùn ye dɑɑwɑ.
Ye bɑ turɑ ɡuuru mi Elisee u wɑ̃ɑ, yerɑ Gehɑsi u kɛ̃ɛ ni mwɑ sɑɑ tɔn ben min di u kɑ dɑ win dirɔ. Mɑ u derɑ bɑ ɡɔsirɑ bɑ doonɑ.
Yen biru u dɑ u win yinni Elisee deemɑ. Mɑ Elisee u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, Gehɑsi, mɑn diyɑ ɑ wee mɛ. U nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ ǹ ɡɑm de ni.

Adɑmɑ Elisee u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ tɑmɑɑ nɛn bwɛ̃rɑ kun kɑ nun wɑ̃ɑ mi, sɑɑ ye durɔ wi, u yɔ̃ɔwɑ u surɑ win tɑbu kɛkɛn di u kɑ nun yinnɑ? Sɑɑ yeni sɔɔrɑ kɑɑ sii ɡeesu mwɑ kpɑ ɑ kɑ yɑbenu kɑ olifin dɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑɑnu dwe, kɑ resɛm mɑrum kɑ yɑɑ sɑbenu kɑ sɔm kowobu?
Tɛ̃, Nɑmɑnin bɑrɑ disiɡii te, tɑ koo wurɑ wunɛ kɑ wunɛn bweseru kpuro sɔɔ, sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ. Mɑ Gehɑsi u doonɑ Eliseen min di, kɑ bɑrɑ disiɡii te. Mɑ tɑ win wɑsin ɡɔnɑ bururɑsiɑ.
Gbɑ̃ɑ yɑrɑ ye yɑ wɔri
nim bwerɔ
